scripts.package:drop: npm --prefix client run build && python -c "import os, zipfile; dist = os.path.abspath('client/dist'); zip_name = os.path.abspath('netlify-drop-static.zip'); zf = zipfile.ZipFile(zip_name, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED); [zf.write(os.path.join(root, f), os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, f), dist).replace(os.sep, '/')) for root, _, files in os.walk(dist) for f in files]; zf.close()"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
